svg.text: Amino-acid pathway genes across 45 Prochlorococcus genomes
Rows: genes in pathway order for each amino acid (biosynthesis, then degradation in italics). Columns: genomes, clustered by gene presence (average linkage, Jaccard).
A gene shared by several amino acids (e.g. ilvE) appears in each of their paths. Gene = any of the listed KOs (PSTA by ortholog group). Source: KEGG KO annotations in the KG.
